identity.name: TIM Rogue Authenticode Code-Signing Certificate IOC — Vidar+XMRig Malvertising Loader (T1587.002 / T1036.001)
identity.summary: The Vidar+XMRig malvertiser signs its loader with fabricated Authenticode certs (CN=justwatch.com/*.bleacherreport.com, CA:TRUE, untrusted chain). TIM arms the rogue thumbprint, serial, and four C2 IPs; XSIAM raises the rogue-signer match (untrusted-chain status + fabricated issuer), matches the C2 IP on NGFW, and pivots on the shared signer — the code-signing axis of Resource Development.
identity.description: Resource Development (TA0042) is the tactic where an adversary builds the capability it will later deploy; developing and abusing code-signing certificates (T1587.002) is one of its highest-leverage moves, because a signed binary is trusted by users and by many controls until the signature is actually verified. This card is the code-signing axis of that tactic, grounded in the Unit 42 Vidar-stealer / XMRig-miner malvertising campaign. The operator lures victims searching for cracked software, delivers a password-protected archive, and executes a Go-compiled loader signed with a FABRICATED Authenticode certificate. Two cert variants were observed: Variant A carries subject CN=justwatch.com, a self-signed issuer 'WR3', serial 2f:7e:f0:15:7d:17:62:5c:09:86:91:ce:f1:ff:7d:63, SHA1 thumbprint ab92f731ab20774dfdb95664ee41a2fbafe2a284, validity 2026-03-09 to 2026-06-07, the CA:TRUE basic-constraint set, and a chain that does not build to a Microsoft-trusted root; Variant B rotates the subject to CN=*.bleacherreport.com under a cloned issuer name 'GlobalSign Atlas R3 DV TLS CA 2026 Q1', again untrusted. The signed loader drops Vidar (MicrosoftUpdate.exe) which exfiltrates browser credentials, cookies, and crypto-wallet data over HTTPS to 136.243.203.109:443, and an XMRig launcher (MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe) that mines Monero; the operator is notified per-victim via the Telegram channel ci0iiif. The TIM value is the pivot the operator's own tradecraft creates: the operator ROTATED the cert subject (JustWatch to BleacherReport) but the underlying capability — a self-signed / cloned-CA cert with CA:TRUE and an untrusted chain — persists, so the fabricated thumbprint and issuer pattern become a durable indicator that stitches otherwise-distinct signed loader samples into ONE campaign. The detection surface: (1) an IOC feed arms the rogue thumbprint, serial, and the four C2 IPs; (2) a BIOC raises the rogue-signer match when a process executes carrying the fabricated thumbprint / untrusted-chain status; (3) an XQL matches the outbound C2 session to the Vidar exfil IP on the NGFW; (4) an XQL pivots on the shared rogue signer (issuer/vendor) to enumerate every co-signed loader and affected host; (5) a correlation rule fuses the rogue-signer execution match and the C2 session into a single Vidar+XMRig malvertising-loader incident anchored to the certificate. Modeled safely: the simulation emits telemetry markers for the rogue-signer execution and the C2 destination without contacting the real (sinkhole-class) infrastructure.

campaigns: Vidar stealer + XMRig miner malvertising campaign (cracked-software lures, rogue Authenticode signing) 2026

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-TIM-005 — TIM rogue-code-signing-certificate IOC feed match + C2 stitch, modeled from the Unit 42 Vidar+XMRig malvertising campaign (telemetry-marker simulation, no live egress).

prerequisites.description: XSIAM TIM feed armed with the rogue Authenticode thumbprint / serial and the four Vidar C2 IPs so the indicators land in the threat_intel dataset.

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM agent forwarding process + signature telemetry (xdr_data) and NGFW forwarding session telemetry (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw) into the tenant.

payload.code:
# SAFE-MODE: emit telemetry markers for the rogue-signer execution and the C2
# destination WITHOUT contacting the real (sinkhole-class) infrastructure.
set -euo pipefail
CERT_THUMBPRINT="${CERT_THUMBPRINT:-ab92f731ab20774dfdb95664ee41a2fbafe2a284}"
C2_IP="${C2_IP:-136.243.203.109}"
echo "[CortexSim][SAFE-MODE] SIM-TIM-005 rogue-signer execution marker: MicrosoftUpdate.exe signed by rogue cert (thumbprint ${CERT_THUMBPRINT}, CA:TRUE, chain untrusted)"
echo "[CortexSim][SAFE-MODE] SIM-TIM-005 outbound C2 marker: Vidar exfil to ${C2_IP}:443 (destination NOT contacted; telemetry-only)"

input_variables.name: CERT_THUMBPRINT
input_variables.description: SHA1 thumbprint of the fabricated Authenticode code-signing certificate the TIM feed arms and the rogue-signer BIOC matches.

input_variables.name: C2_IP
input_variables.description: Vidar HTTPS exfiltration C2 IP the TIM feed arms and the NGFW C2-match XQL keys on. SAFE-MODE never contacts it.

biocs.name: TIM — Rogue Authenticode Code-Signing Certificate Match on Signed-Binary Execution
biocs.description: A process executes carrying the fabricated Authenticode signer the campaign uses to sign its loader — the self-signed 'WR3' or cloned 'GlobalSign Atlas R3 DV TLS CA 2026 Q1' issuer (subject justwatch.com / *.bleacherreport.com) with a signature status that is not validly SIGNED because the chain never builds to a trusted root (CA:TRUE, self-signed / cloned-CA). This is the TIM rogue-signer match: it fires on the certificate capability the operator DEVELOPED (T1587.002 / T1036.001), independent of the loader filename, so subject rotation across variants does not evade it. The atomic thumbprint/serial themselves are armed as certificate indicators in the TIM threat_intel feed (validated by the pre-flight XQL), because xdr_data process telemetry exposes signer status/vendor, not a per-certificate SHA1 thumbprint column.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_signature_status != ENUM.SIGNED
| filter action_process_signature_vendor in ("justwatch.com", "*.bleacherreport.com", "WR3", "GlobalSign Atlas R3 DV TLS CA 2026 Q1")
| comp count() as rogue_signed_executions by agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, action_process_signature_vendor, action_process_signature_status
| filter rogue_signed_executions >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, action_process_signature_vendor, action_process_signature_status, rogue_signed_executions

xql_queries.name: TIM Pre-flight — Rogue Code-Signing Cert IOCs Ingested Into Threat Intel
xql_queries.query:
dataset = threat_intel
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter indicator_value in ("ab92f731ab20774dfdb95664ee41a2fbafe2a284", "2f7ef0157d17625c098691cef1ff7d63", "136.243.203.109", "136.243.203.111", "138.199.246.13", "116.203.243.208")
| comp count() as armed_indicators, count_distinct(indicator_type) as indicator_types by feed_source
| filter armed_indicators >= 1
| fields feed_source, indicator_types, armed_indicators

xql_queries.name: TIM IOC Match — Outbound C2 Session to Vidar Exfil IP
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter dst_ip in ("136.243.203.109", "136.243.203.111", "138.199.246.13", "116.203.243.208")
| filter dst_port = 443
| comp count() as c2_sessions, sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_exfiltrated by src_ip, dst_ip
| filter c2_sessions >= 1
| fields src_ip, dst_ip, c2_sessions, bytes_exfiltrated

xql_queries.name: TIM Pivot — Distinct Signed Loaders Sharing the Rogue Signer
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 604800)
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_signature_status != ENUM.SIGNED
| filter action_process_signature_vendor in ("justwatch.com", "*.bleacherreport.com", "WR3", "GlobalSign Atlas R3 DV TLS CA 2026 Q1")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_sha256) as distinct_loaders, count_distinct(agent_hostname) as affected_hosts by action_process_signature_vendor
| filter distinct_loaders >= 1
| fields action_process_signature_vendor, distinct_loaders, affected_hosts

correlation_rules.name: TIM — Rogue-Signer Execution Match Stitched to Vidar C2 Session
correlation_rules.logic: BIOC(TIM — Rogue Authenticode Code-Signing Certificate Match on Signed-Binary Execution) AND XQL(TIM IOC Match — Outbound C2 Session to Vidar Exfil IP) -> join on agent_hostname = src_host (endpoint_network_stitch pivot) within 600s. Fuses the rogue-signer execution match and the outbound Vidar C2 session into a single malvertising-loader incident anchored to the fabricated code-signing certificate, so the DC sees one incident driven by the subscribed cert IOC rather than two unrelated signals.

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Threat Intel Management — code-signing thumbprint / serial + IP indicator matching
Cortex XSIAM Correlation Engine — rogue-signer execution stitched to C2 session on host

products.evidence_query: dataset = threat_intel | filter indicator_value in ("ab92f731ab20774dfdb95664ee41a2fbafe2a284", "136.243.203.109") | comp count() as hits by feed_source, indicator_type | fields feed_source, indicator_type, hits

dataset = xdr_data | filter action_process_signature_status != ENUM.SIGNED and action_process_signature_vendor in ("justwatch.com", "*.bleacherreport.com", "WR3", "GlobalSign Atlas R3 DV TLS CA 2026 Q1") | fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, action_process_signature_status, action_process_signature_vendor
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw | filter dst_ip in ("136.243.203.109", "136.243.203.111", "138.199.246.13", "116.203.243.208") and dst_port = 443 | fields _time, src_ip, dst_ip, app, bytes_sent

Playbook: enrich the rogue thumbprint from TIM, block the cert thumbprint/serial and C2 IPs, isolate hosts that executed the rogue-signed loader, and pivot on the shared thumbprint to scope every co-signed sample.

threat_scenarios.name: Threat Intel Management — Rogue Code-Signing Certificate IOC Match + C2 Stitch
threat_scenarios.description: Validate that XSIAM TIM arms the fabricated Authenticode thumbprint / serial and the Vidar C2 IPs, raises the rogue-signer match on signed-binary execution, matches the outbound C2 session on the NGFW, and stitches the two into a single malvertising-loader incident anchored to the certificate the operator developed (Resource Development, T1587.002).

threat_steps.objective: The rogue code-signing cert + C2 IOCs are armed in TIM and the rogue-signer match fires on signed-binary execution.
preconditions: XSIAM TIM feed armed with the rogue thumbprint / serial and the four Vidar C2 IPs.
Cortex agent forwarding process + signature telemetry into xdr_data.
steps: Run SIM-TIM-005 step-01 (arm/confirm the cert + C2 indicators in the feed).
Run SIM-TIM-005 step-02 (emit the rogue-signer execution marker).
Inspect threat_intel and the rogue-signer BIOC output.
success_criteria: XQL `TIM Pre-flight — Rogue Code-Signing Cert IOCs Ingested Into Threat Intel` returns >= 1 row.
BIOC `TIM — Rogue Authenticode Code-Signing Certificate Match on Signed-Binary Execution` fires on the fabricated thumbprint with an untrusted-chain status.

threat_steps.objective: The outbound C2 session matches a feed IOC and the correlation rule stitches the rogue-signer match to the C2 session into one incident.
preconditions: NGFW forwarding session telemetry into panw_ngfw_traffic_raw.
steps: Run SIM-TIM-005 step-03 (emit the Vidar C2 destination marker).
Inspect the correlated incident and the thumbprint pivot.
success_criteria: XQL `TIM IOC Match — Outbound C2 Session to Vidar Exfil IP` returns >= 1 row.
Correlation `CR-TIM-0005` raises one incident stitching the rogue-signer match and the C2 session on the host.
XQL `TIM Pivot — Distinct Signed Loaders Sharing the Rogue Cert Thumbprint` enumerates the co-signed samples sharing the thumbprint.

preventive_controls: Enforce Authenticode signature VERIFICATION (chain-to-trusted-root, not merely 'is signed') in application-control and WildFire verdicts so a CA:TRUE self-signed / cloned-CA cert is treated as unsigned.
Block execution of binaries whose signer chain does not build to a Microsoft-trusted root via WDAC / application allow-listing.
Apply Advanced URL Filtering + DNS Security to the malvertising delivery chain and deny direct server-subnet egress to non-sanctioned destinations.
detection_engineering: Arm TIM with the fabricated cert thumbprint AND serial (not just the subject CN) so subject rotation across campaign variants does not evade the indicator.
Pivot on the shared code-signing thumbprint/issuer to enumerate every co-signed loader sample and affected host, treating the certificate as the durable campaign key.
Stitch the rogue-signer execution match to the outbound C2 session on the same host within a tight window rather than alerting on either signal alone.

changelog.author: Henry Reed
changelog.change: Promoted the SIM-TIM-005 research-intake scaffold to an authored card grounded in the Unit 42 Vidar+XMRig malvertising campaign. Fills the RESOURCE-DEV (TA0042) gap via T1587.002 code-signing-certificate development: 5 IOCs (4 Vidar C2 IPs + Vidar SHA256), a rogue-signer BIOC keyed on the fabricated Authenticode thumbprint/serial/issuer with untrusted-chain status, a threat_intel feed-ingest preflight XQL, an NGFW C2-IP-match XQL, a shared-thumbprint pivot XQL, and correlation CR-TIM-0005 stitching the rogue-signer execution match to the C2 session. IOC-emphasis, F1. Promoted to active.
